findingClass: the closed-IPO job records an IPO DONE although the field-plan walk never asked any of its fields (no plan rows, or plan rows none of which carries last_attempt_at) -- DONE is never re-picked, so the IPO leaves the backlog with nothing done (#717, OD-76)
failThreshold: any closed_ipo_resourcing row with outcome = 'DONE' whose IPO has zero ipo_field_plan rows with last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL (this includes an IPO with no plan rows at all); reported by IPO name with its plan and walked row counts
unverifiableWhen: closed_ipo_resourcing does not exist on the slot (migration 0050 not applied)
